Name: Draco Jaw
Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Burn (1) the Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Frostbite (1) the Foe.
Description: The User bites into the Target with its ancient draconic energy. The primordial forces of fire, ice and electricity permeates the attack.
